Remark
[Scale-invariance of the statement] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0181 1. ch21:21.5\group Pseudolocality theorem

Under $\widetilde g(t)=Cg(C^{-1}t)$ and $\widetilde r_0=C^{1/2}r_0$, the curvature lower bound, almost-Euclidean isoperimetric condition, and the conclusion of Theorem 1 are unchanged. In particular, $|\Rm _{\widetilde g(t)}|=C^{-1}|\Rm _{g(C^{-1}t)}|$.
